title.es: Casino Monte Carlo Noche de Fiesta
title.pt: Cassino Monte Carlo Noite de Festa

generated.description: A very large casino-style entertainment building with a Monte Carlo theme, built mostly from sandstone, stone bricks, glass, and red, yellow, and black wool on a grass and dirt base. It spans about 152 by 124 blocks and rises roughly 49 blocks high, with a wide, layered facade. The interior includes chests, an enchanting table, furnaces, a jukebox, a record player, signs, and a cauldron, suggesting a party or nightlife space.
